method: Same-origin iframe in cloud Chrome; no CPU/network throttling; sequential samples with shared cache and heap
limitations: LCP and CLS are laboratory observations, not field p75; scrolling/clicking and automation can affect timings.
maxObservedInteractionMs is Event Timing output, not an INP implementation; the 9208ms outlier is not attributed to application code without a trace.
performance.memory is shared Chromium heap and fluctuates with GC; values are not isolated retained component memory.
The archive fixture has text-only cards and books reuse one cover; image payload cannot be extrapolated to a real collection.
Cache was shared across samples. A 304 may report zero encoded bytes; use the image inventory for original asset sizes.
The iframe reproduces responsive CSS viewport width, not an actual phone's CPU, DPR, browser chrome or network.
The performance build uses CSR even for the Home; the production Home is prerendered, so initial navigation timings are not equivalent.
